mintAuthority.summary: USBD has six independent native Liquity-v1-fork CDP issuance deployments on Ethereum, Hemi, Plume, Sonic, BSC, and Nibiru. Each local BorrowerOperations path is collateral/debt-ceiling bounded, but the shared BimaCore owner EOA can mint directly without limit, install new mint adapters or TroveManagers, and raise ceilings. LayerZero OFT peer/delegate administration is a separate bridge capability reviewed under Bridge Risk.

controls.label: BIMA BorrowerOperations (Liquity-v1 fork)
controls.capDescription: Mint gated by per-collateral debt ceilings and a 150% minimum collateral ratio enforced by the TroveManager/Factory.
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25770562, the local DebtToken pointed to this BorrowerOperations contract; the local BorrowerOperations, Factory, and BimaCore owner paths remained linked to the separately modeled EOA. It is the user-facing CDP minter bounded by collateral checks and per-market maxSystemDebt and cannot raise its own ceilings.

controls.label: BimaCore governance / parameter admin
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25770562, BimaCore.owner()/guardian(), Factory.owner()/guardian(), and BorrowerOperations.owner() resolved to this code-empty EOA; the local DebtToken remained linked to the local Factory and BorrowerOperations and its lendingVaultAdapterAddress remained zero. Verified source gives this owner unbounded authorizedMint, adapter replacement, new TroveManager authorization, and maxSystemDebt raise paths.
controls.capDescription: Unbounded: DebtToken.authorizedMint() has no cap, and this EOA can also raise each collateral maxSystemDebt via TroveManager.setParameters().

controls.label: BIMA Hemi BorrowerOperations (material native CDP minter)
controls.capDescription: Hemi native CDP issuance is bounded by collateral checks and per-market maxSystemDebt; this BorrowerOperations contract cannot raise those limits.
controls.evidence: At Hemi block 5087661, the local DebtToken returned this BorrowerOperations address and its local Factory; BorrowerOperations.owner(), Factory.owner(), and BimaCore.owner() all resolved to the separately modeled EOA, while the token's lendingVaultAdapterAddress remained zero.

controls.label: BimaCore Hemi governance / parameter admin
controls.capDescription: Unbounded: the same owner-only authorizedMint, adapter replacement, Factory authorization, and maxSystemDebt parameter paths are deployed on Hemi.
controls.evidence: At Hemi block 5087661, BimaCore.owner()/guardian(), Factory.owner()/guardian(), and BorrowerOperations.owner() all returned this code-empty EOA. The Hemi deployment therefore has the same unbounded direct-mint and authorization bypass surfaces as Ethereum, with no multisig or timelock.

controls.evidence: At Plume block 87682495, the local DebtToken pointed to the local BorrowerOperations path and the direct deployment had a zero EIP-1967 implementation slot. The local BimaCore owner/guardian is separately modeled as the uncapped native administrator.

controls.evidence: At Plume block 87682495, the local BimaCore owner and guardian resolved to this code-empty EOA; the direct deployment had a zero EIP-1967 implementation slot. review.evidence: Fixed-block reads on 2026-08-16 confirmed the same local native CDP mint path on Ethereum 25770562, Hemi 5087661, Plume 87682495, Sonic 77632123, BSC 116350940, and Nibiru 44572760: each local DebtToken points to its local BorrowerOperations/TroveManager stack, each local BimaCore owner/guardian is the code-empty EOA 0xaca5d659364636284041b8d3acad8a57f6e7b8a5, and each direct deployment has a zero EIP-1967 implementation slot. Verified Bima source permits that shared owner to call uncapped authorizedMint, install a mint-capable adapter, authorize new TroveManagers, and raise per-market maxSystemDebt. The separate DebtToken owner/delegate EOA 0xe3fbba95bb35be804696624dd1e9344a86e3cbc4 controls LayerZero OFT peers and application/delegate configuration and is authored only under Bridge Risk. Aggregate native mint semantics remain unbounded, reconciliation is not applicable, no Safe modules or guards apply, and no prudential supervisor was identified.
